did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. A shop (paikari account) put the same phone case from two different sellers into one market cart and sent one checkout.

checks.text: The cart splits into Package 1 (first seller) and Package 2 (Rahim Traders), each with its own delivery charge (70 and 80)
One "Send the orders" button places both; the buyer lands on "Your packages" with two packages and one total (2,547)
Each seller sees only their own order, not the other seller's

notes: Done by hand in the live browser, not by a script.

While testing, the button "Add to the market cart" gave no sign on a phone (the message was far above it). That was fixed: the confirmation or the reason it was refused now sits right above the buttons.

shots.caption: "Added to your market cart." now shows beside the button
One cart, two packages, one per seller
